Search commands

!copy

Copy all words on the current results page (up to 100 words).

!download

Download all words on the current results page as a TXT file.

!yranoilraf

Reverse every entry in the active dictionary. Example: cupcake becomes ekacpuc.

!farlionary

Restore all reversed entries to their original spelling. This is the only command that can undo !yranoilraf.
